task: Write a practical email of about 70–110 words to members of a fictional community choir. Explain the rehearsal-room change, what members should bring, and how to enter. Most readers know the old venue arrangement. Make clear what has changed and what has not; do not turn the message into a promotional announcement.

facts.text: Thursday's rehearsal remains scheduled for 6:30–8 p.m.
The rehearsal has moved from Bellhouse's main hall to its side studio.
The studio has a ground-level entrance from the same courtyard.
A keyboard will be provided in the studio.
Singers should bring their music folders.
Percussion instruments are not needed for this session.
The main hall has been reserved for costume fittings.

forbidden_additions: A changed rehearsal time, cancellation, or permanent relocation.
A claim that the main hall is damaged or unsafe.
A requirement to bring a keyboard or percussion instruments.
preserve: The distinction between the changed room and unchanged rehearsal time.
Concrete arrival and equipment information for existing members.
